items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Jonah Joe Jones was playing with Stuff Smith at the time, and they came out to hear the band, see.

ctx.x: That's right. Because we were booked in Chicago at the Savoy Ballroom. And -- because Stuff Smith was playing in Chicago and he came out to -- and Jonah Joe Jones. Jonah Joe Jones was playing with Stuff Smith at the time, and they came out to hear the band, see. And we played at the Savoy
Ballroom to a nice crowd, to a real nice crowd. It wasn't no knockdown, dragout crowd, but a real good crowd. // (End of Tape #9.)
